result.markdown: --- title: >- [markdown_to_plaintext()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Parse CommonMark/GFM and render as plain text. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/multimark/blob/feat-markdown-to-plaintext/src/multimark/_cmark.py#L726-L846){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python markdown_to_plaintext( text, *, hardbreaks=False, smart=False, normalize=False, unsafe=False, footnotes=False, extensions=(), width=0, options=0, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Removes heading, emphasis, link, and code delimiters while preserving their text. Link destinations and image URLs are omitted; image descriptions are retained. Lists keep their markers and indentation, and paragraphs remain separated by blank lines. GFM tables retain pipe-table syntax, task lists retain checkbox markers, and strikethrough text is surrounded by single tildes. Enabled footnotes retain numbered references and definitions. Raw HTML blocks, including their text, are omitted; inline HTML tags are omitted without removing surrounding text. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [text]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The Markdown string to parse and render. Must be a Python `str`. [hardbreaks]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Render soft line breaks as hard breaks (newlines). By default, this is `False`. When enabled, width-based wrapping is disabled. [smart]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convert straight quotes to curly quotes, `--` to en-dashes, `---` to em-dashes, and `...` to ellipses. By default, this is `False`. [normalize]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Consolidate adjacent text nodes in the parsed AST. By default, this is `False`. [unsafe]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Raw HTML is always omitted, regardless of this flag. By default, this is `False`. [footnotes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Enable footnote syntax parsing. By default, this is `False`. [extensions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Sequence[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [()]{.doc-parameter-default} : A sequence of GFM extension names to enable. Valid names are `"table"`, `"strikethrough"`, `"autolink"`, `"tagfilter"`, and `"tasklist"`. [width]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The column at which to wrap output lines. Set to `0` (the default) to disable line wrapping entirely and preserve soft line breaks. With a positive width, soft line breaks become spaces before wrapping. Code blocks are not wrapped. Ignored when `hardbreaks=True`. [options]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : An integer bitmask of `Options` flags (e.g., `Options.SMART | Options.UNSAFE`). Merged via OR with any boolean keyword arguments set to `True`. Defaults to `0`. `Options.NOBREAKS` converts soft line breaks to spaces and disables automatic wrapping. ::: ## Keyword Arguments Vs. Options Flags {.doc-keyword-arguments-vs-options-flags} The boolean keyword arguments (`smart`, `unsafe`, `hardbreaks`, etc.) are convenience shortcuts for the most common `Options` flags. When both styles are provided, they are merged via OR. See `markdown_to_html()` for a detailed explanation. ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The rendered text, including a trailing newline. Empty input returns `"\n"`. Output whitespace is not stripped. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Remove inline formatting: ::: {#ed635f6f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from multimark import markdown_to_plaintext markdown_to_plaintext("**Hello**, *world*!") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 'Hello, world!\n' ``` ::: ::: Wrap readable text at 72 columns: ::: {#f6ab8477 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} markdown_to_plaintext("A paragraph with **bold** text. " * 5, width=72) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 'A paragraph with bold text. A paragraph with bold text. A paragraph with\nbold text. A paragraph with bold text. A paragraph with bold text.\n' ``` ::: :::
